newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp says on track for forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp says on track for forecasts.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd chief executive officer Graham Kraehe said on Thursday that he expected the company to achieve profits around current market expectations, although the appliance division was performing below expectations.
"Packaging is in line with expectations, wine is, and water heaters are also in line, but appliances are performing below our expectations,"
"So in total we expect to be in the range of market expectations," Kraehe told reporters after a luncheon address.
Kraehe has said previously that market expectations were for a net profit before abnormals for the 1996/97 year ending June 30 of around A$130 million.
Southcorp reported a net profit of A$124.2 million in 1995/67 including an abnormal loss of A$630,000.
